description:
We are actively seeking a dedicated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead the clinical team at a reputable skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is an exceptional opportunity for a compassionate and strategic nursing leader to make a significant impact on patient care and staff development.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of care, and maintaining regulatory compliance. This vital leadership role offers a competitive salary range of $85,000 - $95,000 per year, reflecting the importance of this position. We are looking to fill this role quickly with a passionate professional committed to excellence.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of nursing leadership experience, preferably in a skilled nursing or long-term care setting
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations for skilled nursing facilities
Proven ability to manage and mentor nursing staff
